title: CVE-2026-9218 — Insufficient input validation vulnerability in Certain NETGEAR routers allows unauthorized access
summary: Affected: NETGEAR CBR40, NETGEAR R7000, NETGEAR R7000P, NETGEAR RAX40 Insufficient input validation vulnerability in time server (NTP) setting of the listed NETGEAR models allows an attacker who is connected to the router’s local network and has the router’s administrator credentials to run unauthorized commands on the router. This vulnerability could impact the integrity of the affected router. There is no impact on confidentiality or availability of the affected router.

title: CVE-2026-97858 — Guangzhou Juan IoT Technology EseeCloud Improperly Controlled Modification of Dynamically-Determined Object Attributes
summary: Affected: Guangzhou Juan IoT Technology Co., Ltd. EseeCloud App, Guangzhou Juan IoT Technology Co., Ltd. EseeCloud Firmware An attacker can cause the server to unbind the target device from its current owner and rebind it to the requesting account, regardless of whether the device is currently bound to a different account, allowing an attacker to obtain the device's full serial ID.

title: CVE-2026-97470 — Tourfic <= 3.0.1 - Authenticated (Subscriber+) Stored Cross-Site Scripting via Comment Content via unfiltered_html Gran…
summary: Affected: themefic Tourfic – AI Powered Travel Booking, Hotel Booking & Car Rental The Tourfic – AI Powered Travel Booking, Hotel Booking & Car Rental plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via Comment Content via unfiltered_html Grant to Customer Role in all versions up to, and including, 3.0.1 due to insufficient input sanitization and output escaping. This makes it possible for authenticated attackers, with subscriber-level access and above, to inject arbitrary web scripts in pages that will execute whenever a user accesses an injected page. This requires WooCommerce to be active, but since the customer role is freely self-registerable without admin approval, exploitation is effectively possible by any unauthenticated visitor who registers a WooCommerce account. While the plugin's own listing-page templates sanitize output with wp_kses_post(), the stored payload is returned unsanitized via the unauthenticated GET /wp-json/wp/v2/comments REST endpoint (content.rendered) and post/comment RSS feeds, exposing any headless client, feed reader, or third-party widget that renders comment content.

title: CVE-2026-96044 — Microsoft Office SharePoint Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
summary: Affected: Microsoft SharePoint Server Subscription Edition No cwe for this issue in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows an authorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network.

title: CVE-2026-92629

title: CVE-2026-89062

title: CVE-2026-88094 — Azure Storage Library Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability
